name: ViaStitcher
description: Fill a selected copper zone with a configurable pattern of stitching vias.
description_full: ViaStitcher is a KiCad PCB Editor action plugin that fills a selected copper zone with a configurable grid of vias. It supports spacing and offset controls, clearance checks, randomized placement, filled-copper validation, and selective removal of vias previously created by the plugin. This fork preview adds optional adaptive refill of copper islands and grid gaps with configurable spacing limits.
